capabilities: Sync vault files with Google Drive
Resolve conflicting edits side by side
Browse and restore past Google Drive revisions
Exclude files and folders from sync
extras: Free and open-source under the MIT License; the README text ends mid-sentence at the author credit.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync through a user's own Google Drive account, particularly on iOS.

relations.evidence: establishes a direct connection between your device and Google Drive

summary: Two-way sync between a local vault and Google Drive, with side-by-side conflict resolution, version history and optional end-to-end encryption.
